text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought Curren Chan to the infirmary 
after she got injured during training, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm sorry, Big Brother... Curren 
got hurt~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm sorry, Big Sister... Curren got 
hurt~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
B-But please don't hate me, okay? Pretty 
please... *teary eyes*
choice_data_list:
If it doesn't heal soon, I might start to 
hate it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, thanks. Onii-chan is always so kind~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, thanks. Onee-chan is always so kind~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'll lie down in bed and 
heal up my injury with some sound, solid 
sleep.
choice_data_list: I'm sure it'll heal up completely soon.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Still... a full recovery, huh...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren really did end up getting 
injured, huh."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seemed Curren Chan was also 
regretting this injury.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Mmm~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Onii-chan, you're mean.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...You're so mean, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Fine then. Curren is gonna pout big 
time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, it took Curren Chan longer 
than usual to recover from her injury.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No way. Curren will do her very best to 
get better. So... so please...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't say such sad things, okay...? 
...Even if Curren messed up today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I want you to cheer me on, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I want my big sister to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren will cheer right up if she has your 
support, Big Brother. Please...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If you cheer me on, Big Sis, Curren will 
get energized right away. Please...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being stared at by Curren Chan's teary 
eyes, my mouth somehow started moving on 
its own—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll be all cute and full of energy again 
in no time, so wait for me, Onii-chanâª

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll be all cute and full of energy again 
in no time, so wait for me, Onee-chanâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren Chan's injury healed 
surprisingly fast, and she was able to 
return to training in no time."
